v1_not_rewritten: data/pallet/results/paper_fast6d_screen_v1 is READ ONLY; its S0/S1/S3/S4 conclusions stand

claim_boundary.population: PAPER_EVAL positive, N 319, already consumed as development data

output_contract_preserved.real_gt_fine_tuning_forbidden: REAL_FT_V1 is never launched; EXPERIMENT_STOP_LOCK records 106/402 left-right ordering violations and 187/402 stale 90-degree permutations

baseline_C0_L0.identical_arm: both C0 and L0 are the same frozen YOLO R0 baseline; two names only so each contrast reads cleanly
baseline_C0_L0.parity_gate: the recomputed ALL summary must match the frozen values to 1e-6, and 40 deterministic frames are dumped per-frame; a mismatch stops every candidate arm before it runs

evaluation_contract.iou3d_definition: oriented_iou_3d with GT extents on BOTH boxes, exactly as run_pose_evaluation.py:165

C1.name: observable-semantics bbox translation refinement
C1.what_v1_got_wrong: V1 S2 built the projected box from all eight corners; YOLO was trained on the min/max of the IN-IMAGE corners only

observable_box_rule.inside_test: finite AND 0 <= u < image_width AND 0 <= v < image_height
observable_box_rule.box: min/max of u and v over the inside corners only
observable_box_rule.below_minimum: C1_UNRESOLVED_OBSERVABLE_BOX — the frame is recorded as unresolved and is NOT quietly counted as a baseline success
observable_box_rule.authority: scripts/self_training_yolo/real_ft_v1/build_real_ft_dataset.py to_yolo_label, corroborated 400/400 against the synthetic convention in REAL_FT_V1_METHOD_LOCK.json label_conversion.box_rule_evidence

residuals.point: 16 coordinate residuals, x and y of 8 corners
residuals.group_balance: each block divided by sqrt of its residual count

C1.reading_rule: a fall in predicted reprojection is not a pass; judgement is GT IoU3D and ADDsym only

arms.L0: frozen YOLO R0 baseline (same numbers as C0)

L2.name: line rotation only, translation frozen — historical F2 semantics

L3.name: line rotation + YOLO point translation refit — historical F3 semantics
L3.line_term_in_translation_stage: forbidden by construction; translation_refit takes corners only

L4.name: yaw-only + point translation refit — historical F4 semantics
L4.role: mechanism diagnostic, never the promotion primary

hybrid_wiring.point_cue: current YOLO R0 keypoints (8 corners). The line model's own corner predictions are NEVER used as pose point input.
hybrid_wiring.base_pose: current frozen YOLO R0 pose R0, t0

line_support.source: support_from_grid on the PREDICTED YOLO corners mapped into the canonical 50 grid
line_support.gt_support_parity_only: may be computed as a parity reference, never entering any paper-facing number

line_checkpoints.inference_preprocessing: paper_s2_real_eval.preprocess_squash — RGB, resize 400x400, mean/std normalise. No new resize convention.

historical_lambda_read_from_file_not_har.note: the two seeds carry different historical values; that contract is followed rather than unified

line_solver_constants_unchanged.note: these are the canonical implementation's own constants, copied here for the record and not altered

optimizer_rules_C1.inherited_from: FAST_6D_SCREEN_LOCK.json optimizer_rules_S1_S2, with the prose huber scale written numerically to prevent the V1 parsing defect
optimizer_rules_C1.tolerance_rationale: scipy defaults of 1e-8 terminate immediately against residuals of order 1e-4; these are solver plumbing, not method parameters
optimizer_rules_C1.nan_or_inf: fall back to t0 and record the frame

exception_policy.mostly_no_op_run: if exceptions make an arm largely a no-op, the run is marked INVALID_IMPLEMENTATION_RUN and the numbers are not used

geometry_convention_gate.required_topology: 0-3 near face, 4-7 far face, top {0,1,4,5}, bottom {2,3,6,7}
geometry_convention_gate.projection_roundtrip_test: project cuboid_model_points(gt_extents) with (R_gt, t_gt) through the frame K and compare index-wise with the manual annotated keypoints; reported per object type
geometry_convention_gate.wood_failure_rule: if the convention cannot be demonstrated for wood, WOOD_LINE_STATUS = BLOCKED_GEOMETRY_CONVENTION and only plastic is evaluated for the line arms; wood is not silently folded into ALL
geometry_convention_gate.gate_statistic: median index-wise reprojection error of the GT pose against the manual keypoints, per object type
geometry_convention_gate.threshold_rationale: the annotation quality bar already recorded in GEOMETRY_RESOLVED_POSE_GT is a few px; 12 px is a deliberately loose sanity bound on INDEX ORDER, not an accuracy claim

unit_tests_T1_T7.reuse_existing: scripts/stage0/multihead/mh_fusion.py run_tests, executed unchanged with its OUT redirected into the V1B namespace so no read-only artifact is written
tests: T1 rotation stage leaves translation exactly
unit_tests_T1_T7.fail_action: LINE_FUSION_IMPLEMENTATION_GATE = FAIL, line arms stop, C1 and the paper closure continue

L3_promotion_requires_all_of.A: both seeds: delta IoU3D >= 0 AND delta ADDsym AUC >= 0
L3_promotion_requires_all_of.B: median over the two seeds: delta IoU3D >= +0.020 OR delta ADDsym AUC >= +0.020
L3_promotion_requires_all_of.D: both seeds: neither rotation median nor translation median worse than baseline by more than 5 percent

C1_promotion_gate.primary: delta IoU3D >= +0.020 OR delta ADDsym AUC >= +0.020
and_simultaneously: the other primary metric at or above baseline
pose coverage drop no more than 0.01 absolute
rotation median and translation median not worse than baseline by more than 5 percent

uncertainty.grouping: the existing 13-session grouping of the 319 population, from AXIS_REVIEW_MANIFEST session_id; no new grouping is invented

subgroups.lighting_source: AXIS_REVIEW_MANIFEST paper_domain, the existing field; sessions carrying 'none' are reported as UNLABELLED rather than guessed from their names
subgroups.subgroups_never_select_the_method: only the ALL gate selects; subgroups are descriptive

runtime_benchmark.trigger: run automatically if L3 passes the gate OR both seeds are positive in direction
runtime_benchmark.never_called_jetson: this is a workstation GPU benchmark

branches.positive: if C1 or L3 is GO, continue automatically to candidate_closure/ (no new training; the arm is already a deployable inference formulation)
branches.negative: if C1 STOP and L3 STOP, invent no new candidate and run PAPER_FRAMING_CLOSURE_V1 instead
